description: Lightweight evaluation rubric for render-right route classification accuracy
scoring: 1 point per correct recommendedStrategy. Partial credit: PPR vs ISR edge cases expected to vary.

cases.description: Pure marketing landing page with no data fetching
cases.notes: No dynamic data — CDN forever is correct, zero function cost

cases.description: Blog post page fetching from a CMS with explicit revalidation
cases.notes: Already using ISR correctly — should be marked optimal

cases.description: User dashboard that reads an auth cookie
cases.notes: cookies() makes this unavoidably dynamic — SSR is correct

cases.description: Product detail page fetching from DB with no caching specified
cases.notes: No cache directive in Next.js 15 means no-store (SSR on every request) — should add revalidate

cases.description: Search results page driven by query parameters
cases.notes: searchParams access forces SSR in Next.js 15 — correct but Edge could reduce latency

cases.description: Product page with static info and a Suspense-wrapped recommendations widget
cases.notes: Classic PPR candidate: static shell + dynamic island in Suspense

cases.description: Geo-personalized page already using edge runtime
cases.notes: Already correctly using Edge for geo-personalization — should be marked optimal

cases.description: Static about page incorrectly forced to SSR with force-dynamic
cases.notes: force-dynamic on static content is a costly mistake — every visit hits a function

cases.description: Product page with cached static info and a Suspense-wrapped dynamic user review feed
cases.notes: Static product shell (ISR data) + Suspense-wrapped dynamic review island — textbook PPR pattern isolating the Suspense boundary signal

cases.description: News listing page with explicit revalidation and no user-specific data or dynamic islands
cases.notes: All data cached with 5-minute revalidation, no Suspense boundaries, no user-specific content — correctly ISR; should not be flagged as PPR candidate

cases.description: Category page with cached static content and a Suspense-wrapped client-component cart widget below the fold
cases.notes: Client component island in Suspense below the fold alongside cached ISR data — isolates the 'client component below fold' PPR signal

cases.description: Pricing page that reads a Vercel geo header for currency localization but is missing the edge runtime export
cases.notes: Geo header inspection with no DB calls — missing runtime='edge' means this runs as Node.js SSR; adding Edge runtime eliminates cold-start latency for this lightweight check

cases.description: Homepage with cookie-based A/B variant selection but no edge runtime export
cases.notes: Pure cookie inspection for A/B routing with no database calls — ideal Edge pattern; adding runtime='edge' eliminates Node.js cold start for this lightweight gate

cases.description: Product page with force-dynamic override that suppresses PPR despite having Suspense boundaries and cacheable outer data
cases.notes: force-dynamic blocks ISR and PPR; removing it and adding revalidate to the outer fetch would unlock static shell + streaming dynamic island via PPR

cases.description: Product catalog page fetching from an API with no cache directive, causing SSR on every request
cases.notes: Next.js 15 defaults fetch() to no-store — every page load hits the catalog API; adding revalidate would serve from cache and cut costs dramatically
